topography.project_purpose: Risk Curators. Structurally: 195 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 5 ERC4626 vaults, 15 ERC20 tokens, 5 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 31 common project-authored base contract(s) (ammopenswapservicebasev1, accessmanagedupgradeable, universalreader). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
